description: This PHP class 'Serve' is a command in a CLI application that sets up and runs a documentation server using the Daux library. It configures server options, prepares configuration data, and initiates a PHP built-in server to serve documentation content.

classes.name: Serve
classes.description: A console command class for serving Daux documentation via PHP's built-in server, allowing configuration of host and port.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, and options for host and port.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to start the documentation server, sets environment variables, and runs PHP's built-in server.
